description: Voirie locale de la Corrèze is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.application.i2. LVOIRIELOCALEBDTL019 Municipal and intercommunal roads in Corrèze (seized in 2013) on the basis of the bd topo. This database will be updated based on information collected from communities. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Local Corrèze Road" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2016-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
